head: Lil Booth photo booth app for iPhone makes four-shot strips
dek: Lil Booth is a 99-cent photo booth app for iPhone: pick a look and a frame, take four photos on a 3-2-1 countdown and save the finished strip to Photos. It was #39 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 13 November.
details: It has seven looks such as Film, Toy and Neon, nine frame styles and eight themes for the app itself. There are no accounts, ads or subscriptions, and it can save to your Photos library but not read it. It needs iOS 27 and is made by Jon Schlueter.
means: If you like photo booth strips at parties, you can make them on your phone for a one-time 99 cents.
todo: Search Lil Booth on the App Store; check your iPhone runs iOS 27 first.
